cohort: Pregnant women with HIV positive status at a tertiary care hospital in India between January 2014 and December 2016
finding: Adverse outcomes were associated with untreated maternal HIV infection in pregnancy, and PMTCT services were underutilized by women with low education levels.
mod_finding: Vaginal deliveries accounted for 83.5% of births, while caesarean sections made up 16.5%.
birth_weight: >2.5 kg in more than 50% of cases
